supplies.ja: 通常の対数下界を与え、飯高ファイバー上で二つの非負な項を0にする。parameter fieldの構成に使う。
supplies.en: Supplies the logarithmic lower bound and forces two nonnegative terms on an Iitaka fiber to vanish, enabling the parameter-field construction.

connections.conditions: Surjective connected-fiber morphisms between smooth projective spaces; reduced SNC boundaries; support inclusion. Only the projective case is used.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 制限した変動のHodge lineに随伴正値性を与える。切断次元の上界と合わせて随伴比較の底を点にし、Mの有理自明性を得る。
supplies.en: Gives adjoint positivity for the restricted Hodge line. The section bound forces its adjoint base to be a point and makes M rationally trivial.

connections.conditions: Apply to the restricted integral ambient pure variation; its entire highest line is rank one. A complex summand need not have its own lattice.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 同じ対と非常に一般のファイバーに下界を与え、RAの上界と合わせて加法性にする。
supplies.en: Supplies the lower bound for the same pair and very general fiber; combining it with RA’s upper bound gives additivity.

connections.conditions: Reduced SNC boundaries and support inclusion; the extra stratum-smoothness assumption is required by RA, not by OI. No OI input into RA Theorem 1.1.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 元のXを参照空間に固定し、相対・絶対の切断と比を保持する。追加の通常相対飯高構成で相対bignessを得る。
supplies.en: Preserves relative and absolute section systems and their ratios on the fixed original X, giving relative bigness in the additional ordinary construction.

connections.conditions: Kodaira-zero generic pair; strict plus reduced exceptional source boundary; reference-space condition.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 被約境界と最小指数のroot coverから全最高部分をrank oneにし、正規化済みMを純粋整変動のlineとして実現する。
supplies.en: For a reduced boundary, the least-index root cover makes the entire top piece rank one and realizes the normalized M as a line in a pure integral variation.

connections.conditions: Reduced SNC boundary and logarithmic Kodaira dimension zero. The assertion does not extend to arbitrary rational boundary coefficients.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 実際のsource成分での最小値と全付値のlctを区別してBを正規化する。切断比較とHodge lineを同じモデル上で使う。
supplies.en: Normalizes B by comparing the minimum over actual source components with the lct over all valuations, on the same model as the section and Hodge-line comparison.

connections.conditions: Prepared SNC model, reduced effective boundary, actual relative canonical orders; later source modifications use the prescribed boundary.

checking.limits: The statement and receiving use were compared in this synthesis; the complete valuation and model-change argument remains unverified.

supplies.ja: 境界0のAlbaneseファイブレーションに適用し、非消滅反例のirregularityを0にする。LAでの劣加法性の用途はここに限る。
supplies.en: Applied with zero boundaries to the Albanese fibration, it forces irregularity zero for a nonvanishing counterexample; this is LA’s sole use of subadditivity.

connections.conditions: Smooth projective base of maximal Albanese dimension; nonnegative fiber Kodaira dimension comes from lower-dimensional induction. LA p.6 also records an HPS alternative.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 相対飯高底へ移して一般ファイバーを小平次元0にし、低次元への帰納法を続ける。
supplies.en: Passes to the relative Iitaka base with Kodaira-zero general fiber so that lower-dimensional induction can continue.

connections.conditions: Class C with rational SNC boundary; nonnegative fiber Kodaira dimension; strict plus reduced exceptional convention.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 水平境界を少し下げたbigなファイバーを射影的stable familyに比較し、代数次元0でbigな場合を排除する。
supplies.en: Compares the big fibers, after lowering the horizontal boundary, with a projective stable family, excluding the big case at algebraic dimension zero.

connections.conditions: Positive-dimensional big general fiber; effective horizontal rational SNC boundary with coefficients strictly below one.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 切断空間と実際の有理Hodge lineを比較し、M=p*Pと底の随伴bignessを得る。余次元2へ落ちる項の符号は別途扱う。
supplies.en: Compares section spaces and the actual rational Hodge line, giving M=p*P and adjoint bigness on the projective base; signs above codimension two require separate work.

connections.conditions: Prepared rank-one fibration; zero log Kodaira dimension of very general fibers; fixed reference space. KA Assumption 1.1 remains in force.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: bigな底の捻りから非零切断を作り、別の有効因子と補間して正の小平次元を強制する。
supplies.en: Produces a section after a big base twist; interpolation with another effective divisor forces positive Kodaira dimension.

connections.conditions: Nonzero fixed relative log system, rational SNC boundary, smooth projective base; these hypotheses are checked explicitly at KA p.99.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: BDPPで擬有効となる各閉ファイバーにsemiampleなgood modelと有効例外差を与える。canonical性を確認してTajiを適用する。
supplies.en: Provides a semiample good model and effective exceptional comparison for each closed fiber whose canonical class is pseudo-effective by BDPP; canonicality then permits Taji’s theorem.

connections.conditions: Smooth projective surjection, all closed fibers non-uniruled. This input belongs only to Corollary 1.3, not to WV Theorem 1.1.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 係数1を含む任意次元class Cのorbifold劣加法性を、受け手が明記する前提に対応させる。
supplies.en: Matches full class-C orbifold subadditivity, including coefficient one and arbitrary dimensions, to the recipient’s explicit premise.

connections.conditions: Invariant base, permitted modifications and neat-model convention. The other CK assumptions are not discharged.

checking.limits: Statement and premise compared; neat-model theory and all subsequent CK applications were not independently reverified.

supplies.ja: 制限上でtensor replacementを作り直す別の随伴比較。WV本文は直接比較を採用する。
supplies.en: An alternative adjoint comparison requiring a fresh tensor replacement on each restriction; WV uses the direct comparison.

connections.conditions: No common tensor exponent across restrictions is required.

checking.limits: Input statement and recipient compared by worker D; HQ rechecked WV p.25 and both articles. PH §§8–9 proofs remain unverified.

supplies.ja: smooth族で下界と加法性を比較し、有限のκ(F)を消してVar(f)≤log κ(V)を得る。
supplies.en: For smooth families, compares the lower bound with additivity and cancels finite κ(F) to obtain Var(f)≤log κ(V).

connections.conditions: κ(F)≥0 and log κ(V)≥0. This route does not cover the negative-base branch or every special base.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

supplies.ja: 通常劣加法性への別証明。PHからOI主定理への入力としては扱わない。
supplies.en: A separate proof of ordinary subadditivity; no input from PH into OI’s main theorem is asserted.

connections.conditions: Shared ordinary projective characteristic-zero conclusion; hypotheses of the Hodge-line tools differ.

checking.limits: The full proofs of the input and receiving result were not independently verified.

comparisons.ja: いずれもHodge lineの随伴正値性と弱正値性を補間に使う。OIのcomplex summandとPHのentire highest lineの仮定は同一ではない。
comparisons.en: Both combine adjoint positivity of a Hodge line with weak positivity and interpolation. OI’s complex summand and PH’s entire highest line have different hypotheses.
comparisons.checking: Editorial comparison of the two articles and cited passages; no dependency arrow.

comparisons.ja: root eigenline・境界次数・実際の線束の同定を共有するが、OIは劣加法性、BSはlct moduliの半豊富性を目標とする。BS p.3はorbifold Iitaka theoremを使わないと明記する。
comparisons.en: Both track root eigenlines, boundary orders and actual line bundles, but OI targets subadditivity and BS targets semiampleness of the lct moduli line. BS p.3 explicitly excludes the orbifold Iitaka theorem as an input.
comparisons.checking: Method comparison; other dependencies between the papers remain unexamined.

comparisons.ja: RA §5.1のconnection-form論証はAx–Schanuelの方法を参照する。RA記事は本文内で必要な半単純の場合を論じるため背景として整理している。
comparisons.en: RA §5.1 cites the Ax–Schanuel method for its connection-form argument. The article treats this as background because the needed semisimple argument is supplied in RA.
comparisons.checking: Inherited from RA article and sources.json; external proof not rechecked by HQ.
